subtitle: Dr. Omnia Ahmed - Clinical Nutrition Specialist
feelTired: Feeling tired and exhausted easily? Want a fit and athletic body? Struggling with weight issues?
description1: Want a diet plan that suits your lifestyle? I'm Dr. Omnia Ahmed, a Clinical Nutrition and Obesity Specialist, holding a Pharmacy Bachelor's degree from Assiut University and a Clinical Nutrition Diploma.
description2: I offer online therapeutic nutrition consultations, helping those suffering from obesity or underweight issues, and also provide nutrition for pregnant women, nursing mothers, children, and athletes.
programHeader: In the follow-up program with me, you'll get:

program.benefit1: ✅ A personalized nutrition plan designed specifically for you.
program.benefit2: ✅ Daily follow-up to ensure your commitment and success.
program.benefit3: ✅ Practical tips that fit your lifestyle.
program.benefit4: ✅ Continuous support to achieve your health goals.

reasons.reason1: Over 6 years of experience in pharmacy and medication fields.
reasons.reason2: Over 5 years of experience and professionalism in providing nutritional consultations.
reasons.reason3: Precise and personalized follow-up for each case.
reasons.reason4: Continuous support and motivation to achieve your health goals.
